reason: Value and transfer lens. The idea's own central estimate (+0.001) is already below the +0.002 bar, and a recomputation lowers it. (1) CEILING. One FN->TP is worth 1/135,729 = 7.4e-6 J in the lab (TP 122,151, FP 6,846, FN 6,732; fn_anatomy_exp39.md). A detector can only fix a_never 1,907 + b_swap 2,175 = 4,082 FN (hard cap +0.030). The idea's 5,104 also counts a_tail/a_linefit/a_taken (1,022), where the node already existed. The dense labels exist only for the 44b6 recording (dorado), and 44b6 holds just 167 a_never + 444 b_swap = 611 FN (cap +0.0045 lab). 44b6 annotated nodes are already matched <=7 um at 0.988 (r2_critic.notes.md). The density problem the idea cites is 6bba's (1,740 of 1,907 a_never; the densest 6bba quartile holds 52% of 6bba loss). No dense labels exist for 6bba or for any test embryo, so the claimed gain rests on cross-embryo transfer from ONE embryo. (2) BLEND ARITHMETIC. At det thr 0.965 (logit 3.32), in x138's 0.2 primary + 0.8 aligned secondary blend (exp56 notebook), a missed nucleus where the primary sits at ~-2 logit needs a secondary logit >= 4.65 in the full swap. The DEFAULT averaged variant (0.2/0.4/0.4) needs >= 11.3, so it can essentially not create any a_never node. It only nudges positions, and the swap class is position-driven by <1 um changes that the V1284 head already works on. Also, 3 um NMS and the 0.90 retention guard leave node creation to the full swap only. The 'variance control' variant therefore also removes most of the upside. (3) TRANSFER PRECEDENT. Every secondary change on the LB was negative: weight 0.8->0.5 -0.002, exp08 -0.016, scratch -0.025, exp23 -0.007 (RESULTS.md probes 5/7/10/13). exp08 and exp23 were joint fine-tunes of the same recipe type (lr ~3e-5, 1200 it) on data the model had already fit, and they still did harm. So the harm comes from perturbing a secondary the post-processing is tuned to, not from missing information. Adding dense positives perturbs the logit field MORE, not less. The only controlled external dense-label detector result is also negative: Le Quang Canh, 5 held-out films, official scorer: head-only -0.0033, head+encoder -0.0377 (discussions_summary.md l.214-217). hengck23's dense FOCUS-3D line has no LB proof. (4) NODE MULTIPLIER. Ultrack has ~44% more points than our final nodes on 44b6, and N_est ~0.91 x Ultrack (p10 0.77, p90 1.03). A secondary trained toward Ultrack density pushes N_pred up; each +1% costs ~0.0009. Recalibrating to +-2% on 20 in-sample 6bba videos does not hold on unseen embryos: fine-tune node shifts changed sign across embryos, +3.2% / +5.6% / -6.6% (v_detector-retrain_joint-finetune-long-shot_value.json). The residual +-3% = +-0.0027 is as large as the whole claimed gain. Ultrack over-segmentation (~10% points GT would not count) also teaches duplicates in exactly the dense spots targeted. (5) GATES DO NOT MEASURE TRANSFER. The OOS dorado block is the SAME embryo and the SAME Ultrack convention as ~50% of the fine-tune windows (1:1 sampling), with time-adjacent blocks, so it is biased FOR the new model: it rewards learning Ultrack's convention, including its over-segmentation. The 6bba check is in-sample for both models. No gate touches an unseen, GT-annotated embryo. (6) LB RESOLUTION. Byte-identical notebooks differ by 0.004, so a two-submission difference has SD ~0.003. The +0.003 promotion rule then passes ~16% of the time at zero true effect, against the idea's own P(>= +0.005) ~10%. A pass is roughly a coin flip on being real, and the probe carries ~30-50% harm risk. Recomputed expectation: +0.002 x P(transfer 0.3) for the full swap minus ~0.4 x 0.004 harm => about -0.001 central on public. The averaged default gives ~0 +- 0.002. Both are below +0.002 and inside the noise.
fix_if_any: Not as an LB probe before 29 Sep. A repaired version needs an unseen-embryo, information-isolating test before any slot. (a) Two arms from the same init, with identical steps, lr and sampling: A = 44b6 sparse + dorado dense windows; B = 44b6 sparse only (the same fine-tune perturbation without the new labels). Both exclude 6bba, so 6bba is an honest held-out embryo for the detector. The init must also not have seen 6bba (e.g. a 44b6-only or dorado-only scratch/pretrain), or the comparison inherits the in-sample bias. (b) Score both through the full x138 tail on the 32 densest 6bba videos with the official metric, at matched N_pred (+-1%, threshold re-fit per arm). Gate: A - B >= +0.008 edge J (above sqrt(2) x 0.005 seed noise, and it must hold for 2 seeds), a_never FN down >= 15% in the dense quartile, >= 20/32 videos non-negative, and the N_pred shift at a fixed threshold <= 2% on the 4 dummy test videos. (c) If it passes, ship the FULL swap, not the averaged variant (the averaged blend cannot create nodes: it needs a dense logit >= 11.3). Present it only as a paired probe against the same base, and require LB >= base + 0.004 for promotion. (d) Cheapest pre-kill (CPU, no GPU): on the 63 placed 44b6 clips, count how many exp39 a_never + b_swap FN have an Ultrack point within 3 um and no primary peak >= 0.5 within 3 um. If < 300 (= +0.0022 lab cap), the dense-44b6 mechanism cannot reach the bar and the line is closed. Realistically (a)-(b) is 6-10 GPU-h plus a 6bba x138 lab that does not exist yet, so this is post-deadline research.
realistic_public_gain: about -0.001 central (range -0.008..+0.003). Averaged default variant ~0 +- 0.002 (cannot create new nodes). Full swap: +0.002 x P(transfer ~0.3) minus harm (P ~0.4 of -0.004..-0.016, anchored on 4/4 negative secondary changes and the Le Quang Canh dense-label -0.0033/-0.0377). The idea's own central +0.001 is already below the +0.002 bar and the 0.003 LB noise.
realistic_private_gain: about -0.001 central (range -0.010..+0.003, guess). Private is ~71% other embryos, the dense labels come from one embryo (44b6/dorado) that holds only 16% of lab FN, and the node multiplier drift after a detector fine-tune changes sign across embryos (+3.2/+5.6/-6.6%), so a public-calibrated threshold cannot control it privately.
